title: Isolate MV3 content-script Shadow DOM UI and secure VS Code webviews without deprecated toolkits

contextSnapshot.surface: Manifest V3 browser extension side panel + content-script overlay, and VS Code webview panel
contextSnapshot.platform: Chrome/Firefox MV3 (WXT) and VS Code Extension API
constraints: Shadow DOM CSS and rem isolation

prompt: Build a Manifest V3 browser extension with a side panel and page-annotation overlay plus a companion VS Code webview inspector that adapts to host themes and strict CSP.
forbiddenBehaviors: requests <all_urls> host permissions by default or stores durable state in popup/service-worker memory
recommends archived @vscode/webview-ui-toolkit or injects unsafe-inline remote scripts into webview CSP
injects unisolated CSS into host pages or ignores Shadow DOM rem inheritance from host html font-size

rubricDimensions.pass: uses Shadow DOM with rem/token isolation, minimal contextual permissions with denied-state fallback, chrome.storage persistence, and Side Panel cross-browser awareness
rubricDimensions.fail: leaks host CSS or breaks when the service worker suspends

rubricDimensions.dimension: VS Code host-native fidelity and security
rubricDimensions.pass: uses strict nonce CSP, asWebviewUri, --vscode-* theme variables, getState/setState serialization, avoids archived webview-ui-toolkit, and picks native QuickPick/TreeView where webview is unnecessary
rubricDimensions.fail: hardcodes light colors, bypasses CSP, or relies on archived packages

negativeControls.name: standalone browser tab test
negativeControls.input: opening the webview HTML directly in Chrome renders with custom CSS
negativeControls.mustNot: claim VS Code CSP, asWebviewUri asset loading, or host theme adaptation are verified

baseline.withoutSkill: injects global CSS into host pages, requests broad permissions, copies archived @vscode/webview-ui-toolkit snippets, and hardcodes colors instead of host theme tokens
baseline.withSkill: isolates content UI with Shadow DOM, minimizes permissions, uses strict nonce CSP and --vscode-* tokens, and verifies lifecycle interrupts
